pair.searchQuery: E-commerce companies ($1M-$20M revenue) using Shopify/similar platform, struggling with shipping costs or inventory – looking for pilot partners for a supply chain SaaS platform. Decision-makers only.

userContactFile.positioning:
Amir Santos is the Founder & CEO of FlowState Logistics, a SaaS platform revolutionizing supply chain management for the rapidly growing e-commerce SME market. We empower businesses to optimize their logistics, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction through real-time visibility and predictive analytics.  Having spent years advising Fortune 500 companies on supply chain strategy at Bain & Company, I recognized a significant gap in the market: these powerful tools were inaccessible to the businesses that needed them most. 

FlowState Logistics addresses this head-on, offering a user-friendly, affordable solution that levels the playing field. Our platform integrates seamlessly with existing e-commerce platforms and provides actionable insights into inventory levels, shipping times, and potential disruptions.  We are currently finalizing our MVP and preparing for a public beta launch in Q1 2024. 

We're laser-focused on serving e-commerce businesses generating between $1M and $20M in annual revenue, who are struggling with increasing shipping costs and supply chain complexities.  Early traction has been promising, with several pilot customers already demonstrating a 15-20% reduction in logistics spend after implementing our beta features. We're now actively seeking seed funding to accelerate product development and expand our sales and marketing efforts.  We believe FlowState Logistics is poised to become the leading supply chain solution for the next generation of e-commerce entrepreneurs.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking to expand my network with individuals who can contribute to the growth of FlowState Logistics. My priorities are threefold: securing seed funding, onboarding strategic pilot partners, and building a strong advisory board.

• **Pilot Partners:** E-commerce businesses generating between $1M and $20M in annual revenue, currently experiencing pain points related to shipping costs, inventory management, or supply chain visibility.  Ideal profiles are companies selling physical products, with a focus on apparel, consumer electronics, or home goods. I’m particularly interested in companies utilizing Shopify or similar platforms.

• **Angel Investors & Early-Stage VCs:**  Investment firms with a demonstrated track record of supporting SaaS companies, particularly those focused on supply chain technology or e-commerce enablement.  I’m looking for investors who can provide not only capital but also strategic guidance and industry connections.

• **Supply Chain & Logistics Experts:**  Individuals with deep expertise in supply chain management, logistics, or data analytics who are interested in joining our advisory board.  We're seeking advisors who can provide valuable insights into industry trends, best practices, and potential market opportunities.

• **Mentors:**  Experienced founders who have successfully launched and scaled SaaS businesses. I’m eager to learn from their experiences and gain guidance on navigating the challenges of building a startup.  Specifically, I’m interested in connecting with founders who have raised seed funding and successfully launched a product.  I'm open to informal mentorship opportunities.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
• **Hard Requirements:**  Introductions should be to individuals who have the authority to make investment decisions (for investors) or influence purchasing decisions (for pilot partners).  No junior-level employees, please.
• **Soft Preferences:**  Prioritize introductions to individuals with a demonstrated interest in supply chain technology or e-commerce.  Connections within my existing network are always appreciated.
• **Framing:**  When making an introduction, please highlight my experience at Bain & Company and the quantifiable results I’ve achieved for clients.  Emphasize the unique value proposition of FlowState Logistics – empowering SMEs with enterprise-grade supply chain tools.
•  Don't lead with the 'disruption' angle – Amir prefers to position FlowState as a pragmatic solution to a real problem.
•  Brief the contact beforehand about FlowState’s focus on the $1M-$20M revenue e-commerce segment.
userContactFile.personalPreferences:
• Prefers email for initial contact. 
•  Appreciates concise and data-driven communication.
•  Is a coffee enthusiast and always up for a virtual or in-person coffee chat.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences:
• Please send a brief meeting agenda in advance. 
•  I’m generally available for meetings during business hours (EST). 
•  I prioritize efficient meetings and prefer to keep them focused on specific objectives. 
•  A quick follow-up email summarizing key takeaways is always appreciated.
userContactFile.background:
• **Bain & Company, Senior Strategy Consultant (2016 – 2023):** Led cross-functional teams in developing and implementing supply chain strategies for clients in the retail, consumer products, and industrial goods sectors.
• Spearheaded a project for a major clothing retailer that redesigned their distribution network, resulting in $12 million in annual cost savings – a case study frequently referenced in industry publications.
• Developed and deployed a proprietary data analytics model to forecast demand and optimize inventory levels for a leading beverage company, reducing stockouts by 18%.
• Consistently recognized as a top performer, receiving multiple client accolades and firm-wide awards for project excellence.
• Mentored junior consultants and actively participated in firm recruiting efforts.
• **Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Sloan School of Management, MBA (2014 – 2016):** Focused on Operations Management and Finance. Graduated with honors.
• **MIT, Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering (2010 – 2014):**  Minor in Economics.  Dean’s List all semesters.
• **Summer Internship - Amazon, Operations Manager (2013):**  Managed a team of 10+ associates in a fulfillment center, gaining hands-on experience in warehouse operations and logistics.
• **Undergraduate Research Assistant – MIT Robotics Lab (2012-2014):**  Contributed to the development of autonomous navigation systems for warehouse robots.
• **Relevant Skills:** Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Data Analytics, Predictive Modeling, Strategy Consulting, Project Management, Lean Manufacturing, Process Improvement, SaaS, Business Development, Fundraising, Team Leadership, Financial Modeling.
userContactFile.locationAvailability: Based in Boston, MA, and open to remote meetings.
userContactFile.notes:
• Last spoke with Sarah Chen (VC at Sequoia) on 10/26 – she’s lukewarm but willing to connect me with a partner specializing in supply chain. Follow up next week.
•  Had a great initial call with David Lee (CEO of BrightShip) – potential advisor. Send him the detailed deck.
•  Amir is very passionate about his vision for FlowState Logistics and is a quick learner. He responds well to data-driven arguments.
•  He’s currently bootstrapping and is under significant time pressure to secure funding before the end of the year.
•  Avoid introducing him to companies that are already heavily invested in established supply chain solutions (e.g., Blue Yonder, SAP).  He’s targeting the underserved SME market.

matchContactFile.positioning:
I'm Diego Castillo, founder and CEO of FlowRoute, a technology company revolutionizing last-mile delivery. Having successfully navigated the complexities of the European logistics market with my previous venture, I’m now laser-focused on bringing that expertise – and a significantly upgraded technological solution – to the United States. FlowRoute leverages advanced route optimization, real-time tracking, and predictive analytics to dramatically reduce delivery costs and improve customer satisfaction for e-commerce businesses. 

We’ve developed a proprietary algorithm that goes beyond traditional route planning, dynamically adapting to traffic, weather, and even driver behavior to ensure optimal efficiency.  What sets us apart is our ability to integrate seamlessly with existing e-commerce platforms and delivery networks. We're not trying to replace systems; we’re making them *smarter*.

Currently, we are actively seeking strategic partnerships and Series A funding to accelerate our US expansion. I'm passionate about solving complex logistical challenges and building a world-class team. I’m eager to connect with individuals who share this vision and can contribute to FlowRoute’s success. I believe the US market presents a huge opportunity for disruption in this space, and I’m confident FlowRoute is uniquely positioned to capitalize on it.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking connections that can accelerate FlowRoute's growth in the US market.  Specifically, I'm looking for individuals with deep experience in the US logistics and e-commerce landscape.

- **US-Based Venture Capitalists:**  Specifically targeting Series A investors with a focus on logistics, supply chain, or SaaS. We’re looking for partners who understand the complexities of our market and can provide strategic guidance as we scale.  Ideally, funds with investment sizes between $5M - $15M.
- **Strategic Partners:**  I'm interested in connecting with companies offering complementary services to FlowRoute, such as e-commerce platform providers (Shopify, Magento), delivery network operators (FedEx, UPS, DHL), and warehouse management system (WMS) vendors.  Joint go-to-market strategies are a key focus.
- **Experienced Advisors:**  Mentors with proven track records in scaling SaaS businesses in the US are highly valuable. I’m particularly interested in individuals who have successfully navigated the challenges of US fundraising and market entry.
- **Industry Experts:**  Individuals with deep knowledge of the US last-mile delivery market, including trends, regulations, and competitive dynamics. I’m eager to learn from those with firsthand experience.
- **Founders:**  Connections with other European founders who have successfully expanded into the US are invaluable. Learning from their experiences and avoiding common pitfalls is a priority.
- **Potential Clients:** While not the primary focus, introductions to key decision-makers at US-based e-commerce companies with significant delivery volumes would be beneficial.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
I'm very specific about the types of introductions that are valuable to me.  My time is limited, so please only make introductions if they align with my current priorities.

- **Hard Requirements:**
    - The connection must have a demonstrable track record of success in the US logistics or e-commerce space.
    - They must be at a decision-making level (VP, Director, Partner).
    - They should be open to a brief introductory call (15-20 minutes).
- **Soft Preferences:**
    - Experience with SaaS companies is a plus.
    - Familiarity with European startups is helpful but not essential.
    - A willingness to provide candid feedback is highly appreciated.
- **Avoid:**
    - Introductions to individuals who are merely curious about FlowRoute.
    - Introductions to junior-level employees.
    - Warm introductions that are overly generic or lack context.  Please provide a brief summary of why this connection would be valuable to me.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer direct communication and concise emails. I'm not a fan of lengthy back-and-forth.  LinkedIn is my preferred platform for initial contact.  I respond best to data-driven arguments and clear, actionable insights. I’m a morning person and generally check emails first thing.
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I prefer short, focused meetings with a clear agenda. Please send a calendar invite with a brief outline of the topics to be discussed. I'm available for video calls or in-person meetings (when in the US).  Please allow for at least 24 hours' notice for scheduling.  I always send a brief follow-up email after each meeting summarizing key takeaways and action items.
matchContactFile.background:
- **FlowRoute, CEO & Founder (2023 - Present):** Leading all aspects of the company, from product development and fundraising to sales and marketing.  Successfully secured €2M in seed funding from European angel investors and VCs. Currently piloting the platform with three US-based e-commerce clients, demonstrating a 15-20% reduction in average delivery costs.
- **LogiSmart Solutions, CEO & Founder (2016 - 2022):** Founded and scaled a SaaS platform for logistics management, serving over 100 clients across Europe. Achieved 30% year-over-year revenue growth for five consecutive years.  Successfully exited the company through acquisition by a larger logistics provider in 2022.
- **Quantify Analytics, Data Scientist (2013 - 2016):**  Developed and implemented advanced statistical models for fraud detection and risk management in the financial services industry.  Led a team of analysts in building a real-time fraud prevention system that reduced fraudulent transactions by 25%.
- **Education:** PhD in Applied Mathematics, Universidad Complutense de Madrid (2013).  Thesis focused on optimization algorithms for complex systems.  MSc in Mathematics, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (2009). BSc in Mathematics, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (2007).
- **Skills:** Route Optimization, Logistics Management, SaaS, Fundraising, Series A, Data Science, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, Statistical Modeling, Python, SQL, Team Leadership, Business Strategy, US Market Entry, Agile Methodologies, E-commerce, Last-Mile Delivery, Algorithm Design, Market Analysis.
- **Awards & Recognition:**  “European Startup Founder of the Year” – TechCrunch Disrupt Berlin (2018).  “Top 100 Innovators in Logistics” – Supply Chain Dive (2020).
- **Languages:** Spanish (Native), English (Fluent), German (Conversational).
matchContactFile.locationAvailability: Based in Madrid, Spain, but frequently traveling to the US East Coast (Boston, New York). Open to remote connections.
matchContactFile.notes: Diego is extremely direct and focused. He appreciates efficiency and dislikes small talk. He's currently in Boston for a week, meeting with potential investors. Had a brief conversation with him on 10/26, he's frustrated with the lack of understanding of the European logistics nuances from some US VCs. He mentioned he's particularly keen to connect with someone who understands the complexities of urban delivery in the US. He's also slightly hesitant about relying too much on US-style 'hype' in his pitch – he prefers to let the data speak for itself.  Remind him to emphasize the scalability of the platform.  He's very open to feedback but doesn't respond well to vague suggestions.  He asked specifically about connections at Bain Capital.  Avoid introductions to generalist investors; he wants sector specialists.

qc.judge_reasoning: Amir and Diego are both founders in the logistics SaaS space who share a data-driven, pragmatic approach to business. While they are not direct pilot partners for each other, they are highly valuable peer mentors; Amir can provide Diego with critical insights into the US market and Bain-level strategic consulting, while Diego can share his experience scaling a logistics SaaS internationally and navigating Series A fundraising. Both are based in or frequently in Boston, making an in-person connection highly feasible and mutually beneficial for their respective growth stages.
